output.notes: Described the Pythia v1 suite (standard and deduped copies share identical architecture). The paper uses the GPT-J-style parallel block, set in the config as gpt-j-residual & True: x + attn(norm(x)) + mlp(norm(x)). Two separate layernorms are drawn, but whether the two branches share one norm is not stated. A final norm in the head is likewise assumed. norm_placement is left not_stated: parallel pre-norm is implied but not stated. head_dim (d_model/heads), d_ff, vocab size, eps, rope theta and pairing, and biases are not stated. The partial rotary fraction is 0.25 of each head's dims, so n_rot = 0.25*head_dim, but the number itself is not stated. Activation gelu is inferred from the config key 'bias-gelu-fusion'; exact vs tanh is not stated. Attention heads in block_ops are given for the primary 70M config. Context 2048 comes from seq-length and max-position-embeddings.
